sheridan: Morning! I'm Sheridan — joining as PM on Growth. First day 🎉. Quick asks: 1) I can't access the team Figma files (getting a 403). 2) Where's the product roadmap doc? 3) Who owns the research playbook/process? TL;DR: who to ping for perms + where to read up?

aisha: welcome! :tada: Figma access — tag @design-ops or use the request flow in #devex but easiest: DM me the file link and I'll add you. Also ping morgan for project-level perms.

morgan: hey Sheridan — added you to "Design - Growth" team a sec ago. Try the link now.

sheridan: thanks! link: https://figma.com/file/ABCD1234/growth-design — still 403 for me.

morgan: weird. try incognito? sometimes SSO sticky. also can you paste the email on your profile.

sheridan: sheridan@redwood.com

morgan: done. still 403? if yes, run this in terminal to refresh SSO token:
`open "https://accounts.redwood.com/sso" && killall -HUP browser`
(yes it's ugly :grimacing:)

sheridan: ok trying... yep access works now. 🙌

aisha: roadmap lives in Notion: https://redwood.notion.site/ROADMAP (read-only for new hires). For edits ping robbie (prod lead) or request edit access via /access-request.

robbie: welcome! I'll give you editor on the roadmap. FYI we keep quarterly priorities in the top section; shorthand: 'Serving-Core', 'Runtime perf', 'Dev experience'.

sheridan: awesome — also who owns the research process? want to schedule a quick sync to learn how we run micro-benchmarks and user interviews.

aisha: research ops is in the Research Guild. start with the research playbook: https://redwood.notion.site/research-playbook. cc @morgan for templates and recruiting panel.

morgan: adding you to the research PM channel. For first-week tasks, see checklist: `Onboarding > Product > First 7 days` in Notion. happy to pair on the first interview script.

onboarding-bot: Welcome Sheridan! You've been added to: Design - Growth, Product Team, Research Guild (provisioning may take up to 5 minutes). New-hire checklist updated.

sheridan: perfect — huge help. when is the design critique? would love to join.

aisha: recurring crits Tues 10am PT. Drop into #design-critiques or DM me to get on the invite.

sheridan: will do. thanks everyone!
